description: Get a presigned upload for a DAW PROJECT file (for doseedo_convert_project / doseedo_import_project). Zip a project FOLDER so its audio travels with it. SIZE LIMITS: a single PUT takes up to 5 GB; guest and free accounts convert projects up to 2 GB, paid plans up to 12 GB (a larger one is refused as project_too_large with the cap and an upgrade link). Pass size_bytes: past 4 GB (or with multipart:true) you get a MULTIPART upload instead — a part_size, one presigned part_url per part, and the complete step (doseedo_complete_project_upload); each part is retried on its own, so a dropped connection costs one part, not the upload. Single PUT: `curl -sS -X PUT -H "Content-Type: application/zip" --data-binary @project.zip "<upload_url>"`, then pass project_key on. Multipart: `split -b <part_size_bytes> project.zip part.` then for each piece in order `curl -sS -X PUT --data-binary @part.aa "<part_url>" -D - -o /dev/null | grep -i etag` (keep each ETag), then doseedo_complete_project_upload {project_key, upload_id, parts}. Need more part URLs than one answer holds? Call this again with project_key + upload_id + part_numbers.

content_type.description: MIME type: application/zip for zips (default), application/octet-stream for bare project files.

filename.description: File name including extension, e.g. "Song Project.zip", "beat.flp", "song.cpr" or "score.mxl".

multipart.description: Force a multipart upload regardless of size (resumable per part).

part_numbers.description: CONTINUATION: which part numbers (1-based) to sign now, ≤ 24 per call.

project_key.description: CONTINUATION of a multipart upload: the key the first call returned.

size_bytes.description: The file's size in bytes (stat it). Decides single PUT vs multipart and sizes the parts.

upload_id.description: CONTINUATION: the upload_id the first call returned.

name: doseedo_get_project_upload_url
